summary: Five experiments consumed 174.4 minutes; the three nonzero synthesis-only entries account for all recorded duration. The only compute-bound entry, 'Gated on Exp5772 clean drift headroom: run prospective solver-certified constrai', is consequently the longest compute-bound experiment at 0.0 minutes, with the supplied title establishing only that it was gated. Compute-task GPU idle was not observed, and the data provides no evidence of a concurrent multi-model run or missed DualGPURunner engagement.
bottlenecks_identified: The exact-deliverable evidence index and fail-closed collision preflight was the dominant recorded delay at 87.97 minutes; it was synthesis-only, so GPU inactivity is expected.
Archival and source-delta ingestion added 48.65 and 37.75 minutes of synthesis-only work, concentrating the milestone's elapsed time in evidence handling.
Phase timing and model-count telemetry are absent, preventing causal diagnosis of the gated compute path and direct evaluation of parallel-runner selection.
improvements_suggested: Maintain an incremental, content-addressed exact-deliverable evidence index and run collision checks against only changed deliverables.
Cache validated archival manifests and bibliographic receipts so synthesis closeout can reuse unchanged evidence.
Record per-phase timestamps and task-correlated GPU telemetry with model-count metadata so future retrospectives can separate gate, synthesis, and inference time.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Make evidence indexing and collision preflight incremental.
Reuse validated archival manifests and bibliographic receipts across milestones.
Add phase-level timing plus task-correlated GPU and model-count telemetry.
meta_reflection: The operational leverage is in evidence synthesis, not GPU policy: the three nonzero synthesis entries account for the recorded wall time, while the gated compute entry contributes none. The savings estimate is a bounded planning target equal to halving the 87.97-minute leader, about 25% of 174.4 minutes, rather than a measured result.
